name: Ploughshares Fund
summary: A San Francisco foundation, founded in 1981, that funds and convenes groups working to reduce and eventually eliminate the threat of nuclear weapons: grants to about 46 organisations a year (arms-control research and advocacy, diplomacy with Iran, North Korea and China, media, watchdogs of the weapons laboratories, communities harmed by testing), coalitions of the field, the Nuclear Futures Fellowship and public communications.

spending.source: https://apps.irs.gov/pub/epostcard/990/xml/2026/2026_TEOS_XML_04A.zip (Form 990 for the year ended 30 June 2025, object 202620979349300102, Part IX line 25 (B): programme services $5,679,058 of total expenses $7,613,345)
